name: io.github.tinh2/skills-hub
description: Search & install 13,000+ AI agent skills from skills-hub.ai inside any MCP tool.

tools.name: search_skills
tools.description: Search the skills-hub.ai catalog for AI coding skills. Returns matching skills with metadata. Each result includes a `url` to the skill's page on skills-hub.ai; show that link to the user alongside each skill you mention.

tools.name: get_skill_detail
tools.description: Get full details about a skill including instructions, version, and quality scores. The result includes a `url` to the skill's page on skills-hub.ai; show that link to the user.

tools.name: list_installed_skills
tools.description: Browse the skills-hub.ai catalog sorted by popularity, optionally filtered by category

tools.name: install_skill
tools.description: Record an installation of a skill from skills-hub.ai. If the caller belongs to an organization, the org's install policy is enforced and a blocked install returns an error explaining the policy.
